subject: Post-call recap: Redwood for FinexCorp — Exec summary & next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@finexcorp.com>, Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@finexcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood for FinexCorp — Exec summary & next steps

Sara / Oliver — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick executive-facing recap from our call and recommended next steps so we have aligned expectations.

Summary (verbatim from today)
- Pain points: 1) Unpredictable token costs on peak trading days, 2) failed inference under high concurrency leading to timeouts for risk models, 3) need for stronger audit trails for model inputs/outputs.
- Business goals: reduce inference unit cost by ~30% for bulk scoring, guarantee 99.9% availability for real-time scoring path, and produce auditable logs for regulatory review.
- Success metrics: $/1M tokens, p95 latency <150ms for short prompt routing, KV cache hit-rate >60% for our historic prompt mix.

Proposed executive asks / outcomes we discussed
1) Pilot scope: 4-week technical POC against the credit-scoring model (100k req/day baseline) with a staging environment in us-west and optional burst to dedicated capacity.
2) Procurement path: we recommend an initial 3-month committed capacity with a reserved seat for production transition; Procurement will need SOW, billing contact, and SOC2 evidence.
3) Commercial asks: a single committed SKU for the pilot and a pricing anchor for scale (we can propose committed credits + overage).
4) Risk / mitigations: we will provide an SLA for availability during the POC window and a rollback plan to current infra if measurable regressions appear.

Next steps (owners / timing)
- Redwood: Share executive MAP + cost ballpark and SOC2 summary (by EOD 2/24) — Aditya (owner).
- FinexCorp: Confirm exec sponsor + preferred procurement contact (by 2/25) — Sara / Oliver (owner).
- Technical: Schedule 60-min kickoff to agree test corpus and observability hooks — Vivek / Finex SRE (target 2/26).

Attachments: Redwood-Exec-MAP-FinexCorp.pdf (pilot MAP), SOC2-summary.pdf (controls snapshot).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short one-pager for David (CFO) summarizing financial upside.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--

> Great call — looping Sara and team to confirm next steps.
>
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@finexcorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@finexcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 18:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood for FinexCorp — Exec summary & next steps

Thanks Aditya — good summary. A few clarifications from my side: 
- We like the proposed 4-week POC. Key ask from my side is a clear runbook for data handling (SSO, KMS, and retention) so I can brief legal & compliance.
- Can you provide a 90-day cost estimate (pilot + projected monthly run-rate at 2x / 5x scale)? I need a number to include in the Exec briefing for David (CFO).
- Procurement will pull in the PO process — I’ve cc’d procurement alias on the next thread.

Also: for the pilot, we need the ability to redact raw PII from any logs before they are stored; please confirm Redwood’s support for masking/redaction and where audit logs will be available.

If you can send the exec one-pager and cost ballpark today, I’ll circulate to David and schedule a follow-up 20-min sync.

Best,
Sara Liu
Head of Data & Analytics | FinexCorp
sara.liu@finexcorp.com
From: Procurement <procurement@finexcorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: FinexCorp procurement checklist / PO steps for Redwood pilot

Hi Aditya / Marissa — procurement here. To get the pilot on-contract we need the following: 
1) Draft SOW for the 4-week pilot (deliverables, acceptance criteria, timeline).
2) Master Services Agreement (or standard T&Cs) and Redwood’s primary billing contact and tax ID.
3) SOC2 report or a summary of controls (we requested the SOC2-summary.pdf referenced earlier).
4) Point of contact for security evidence requests (who can answer technical control questions).
5) Estimated pilot value / PO amount (we will need a PO to commit credits).

Please send items 1–4 by EOD 2/25 if possible; procurement will issue a PO within 48 hours of receiving an approved SOW and invoice details.

Thanks,
FinexCorp Procurement
procurement@finexcorp.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood for FinexCorp — Exec summary & next steps

Nice work on the call. Quick internal notes —
- Aditya: please prioritize the one-pager to David with the 90-day cost and the projected 2x/5x run-rate buckets (I can review before you send).
- Marissa / Vivek: prepare a tight SOW template focused on acceptance criteria (latency, availability, audit logs) — legal will need to review standard terms so loop in legal@redwood.com.
- Follow-up ask: we should consider offering a small pilot discount (10%) to accelerate procurement sign-off; I can approve up to 12% for exec-requested pilots, ping me with the final number.

Let me know when the SOW draft is ready — happy to jump on a quick review.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
